plain: To hold back or restrain, like a chain on the feet

webster.text: A chain for the feet; a chain by which an animal is confined by the foot, either made fast or fixed, as a prisoner, or impeded in motion and hindered from leaping, as a horse whose fore and hind feet are confined by a chain.

more.text: To bind; to enchain; to confine; to restrain motion; to impose restraints on.

example.quote: No qualification of wealth, of birth, of religious faith, or of civil profession is permitted to fetter the judgement or disappoint the inclination of the people.
